brief.topic: stablyai/orca as a multi-agent orchestration and execution layer for ZOnePersonNetwork: adoption scope, reusable unit capabilities, semantic fit against a lightweight coordination control plane, ownership cost, and validation gates

criteria.question: What is the declared product positioning, supported surfaces, and execution model?
How are coordinator agents, worker agents, parallel worktrees, and task splitting modelled?
Which agent CLIs are supported and what does provider-neutral integration imply for a WorkBuddy or Codex based workflow?
What agent-controllable CLI, automation, scheduling, and computer-use surfaces exist?
Which trust boundaries, credential, injection, and unauthenticated-service risks does the project itself declare?
What runtime versions, test tooling, cross-platform obligations, and quality gates does the repository declare?
What remote, SSH, daemon, cloud relay, mobile pairing, and telemetry ownership does adoption inherit?
How are diffs, line annotations, commit/PR drafting, and failing checks connected back to agents?
What license, release cadence, supported-version policy, and disclosure process apply?
What is explicitly out of scope, third-party dependent, or deferred?
